notes: Corrective UI release: makes one authoritative weather hero and one health gauge, removes legacy stacked weather/aurora overlays, clips cosmic telemetry inside its own metric cards, restores separate live downstream/upstream readings, adds a hardware-sensor thermometer, turns the uptime tile into an Aurora system clock while preserving uptime text, and uses a single Canvas atmospheric renderer for moving clouds, rain, droplets, fog and storm flashes. Existing Snap and pipx setup from 0.5.9 is preserved.
